Headline: #66 Temporary Eastbound Reroute near Chicago/Laramie
ShortDescription: Eastbound #66 Chicago buses are temporarily rerouted due to, street blockage near Chicago/Laramie.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Eastbound #66 Chicago buses are temporarily rerouted via Chicago, Laramie, Augusta, Cicero and Chicago over regular route: due to, street blockage near Chicago/Laramie.

Westbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.
